segments.authoritative_text: As defined by the Bletchley Declaration, issued by attendees of the UK AI Safety Summit in November 2023, AI safety is a scientific field of research focused on evaluating, preventing, and mitigating risks from advanced AI systems.
segments.source_text: As defined by the Bletchley Declaration, issued by attendees of the UK AI Safety Summit in November 2023, AI safety is a scientific field of research focused on evaluating, preventing, and mitigating risks from advanced AI systems.

segments.authoritative_text: In this case, it refers narrowly to AI systems at or beyond the current state of the art.
segments.source_text: In this case, it refers narrowly to AI systems at or beyond the current state of the art.

segments.authoritative_text: These risks can range from deepfakes to the use of AI for bioterrorism; new risks will emerge as AI's capabilities continue to evolve.
segments.source_text: These risks can range from deepfakes to the use of AI for bioterrorism; new risks will emerge as AI's capabilities continue to evolve.

segments.authoritative_text: Somewhat confusingly, other individuals and organizations may define AI safety more broadly to include lower-performing systems that are not operating at the technical frontier.
segments.source_text: Somewhat confusingly, other individuals and organizations may define AI safety more broadly to include lower-performing systems that are not operating at the technical frontier.

segments.authoritative_text: Still others may or may not include issues around ethics and bias when using the term 'AI safety.'
segments.source_text: Still others may or may not include issues around ethics and bias when using the term 'AI safety.'

segments.authoritative_text: This paper's use of the term 'AI safety' follows the U.S. AI Safety Institute's example of focusing exclusively on safety issues related to advanced AI systems.
segments.source_text: This paper's use of the term 'AI safety' follows the U.S. AI Safety Institute's example of focusing exclusively on safety issues related to advanced AI systems.

segments.authoritative_text: Meanwhile, process-based safety is concerned with the policies, practices, and procedures that surround AI.
segments.source_text: Meanwhile, process-based safety is concerned with the policies, practices, and procedures that surround AI.

segments.authoritative_text: This stream of AI safety is more operational in nature.
segments.source_text: This stream of AI safety is more operational in nature.

segments.authoritative_text: It focuses on how frontier AI developers, deployers, and users build, manage, and monitor AI models, including by evaluating models for capabilities, limitations, and risks, and documenting and reporting model information.
segments.source_text: It focuses on how frontier AI developers, deployers, and users build, manage, and monitor AI models, including by evaluating models for capabilities, limitations, and risks, and documenting and reporting model information.

segments.authoritative_text: It may also include processes that are implemented by the users of AI.
segments.source_text: It may also include processes that are implemented by the users of AI.

segments.authoritative_text: Beyond preventing adverse risks, AI safety serves to accelerate adoption and innovation by building public trust.
segments.source_text: Beyond preventing adverse risks, AI safety serves to accelerate adoption and innovation by building public trust.

segments.authoritative_text: As Elizabeth Kelly, director of the U.S. AI Safety Institute, said in a CSIS interview , 'safety promotes trust, which promotes adoption, which drives innovation.'
segments.source_text: As Elizabeth Kelly, director of the U.S. AI Safety Institute, said in a CSIS interview , 'safety promotes trust, which promotes adoption, which drives innovation.'

segments.authoritative_text: AI safety boosts public trust by allowing people to pause, stop, or change course as needed.
segments.source_text: AI safety boosts public trust by allowing people to pause, stop, or change course as needed.

segments.authoritative_text: To keep pace with the cutting edge of AI safety research, AISIs have prioritized the hiring of technical staff and opened offices in cities with deep pools of AI talent like San Francisco.
segments.source_text: To keep pace with the cutting edge of AI safety research, AISIs have prioritized the hiring of technical staff and opened offices in cities with deep pools of AI talent like San Francisco.

segments.authoritative_text: In addition to developing expertise internally, AISIs aim to cultivate a robust ecosystem of AI safety researchers in labs, industry, and academia through their guidance on best-in-class evaluation methods.
segments.source_text: In addition to developing expertise internally, AISIs aim to cultivate a robust ecosystem of AI safety researchers in labs, industry, and academia through their guidance on best-in-class evaluation methods.

segments.authoritative_text: Note that while these nine areas of guidance overlap with the nine core functions of an AI safety institute identified in Section 4 of this paper, they do not cover the full breadth of AISIs' operations.

segments.authoritative_text: The letter echoes similar calls for Congress to authorize the AISI by Scale AI Founder and CEO Alexandr Wang earlier in October, as well as a letter from top AI companies to establish the AISI on a statutory basis in July.

segments.authoritative_text: The July letter, also published by Americans for Responsible Innovation and ITI, argues that authorizing the AISI "provides a venue to convene the leading experts across industry and government to contribute to the development of voluntary standards that ultimately assist in de-risking adoption of AI technologies.

segments.authoritative_text: While the concept of a government organization that works closely with AI companies on safety is still new, history shows that this kind of arrangement between government and industry can be highly successful.
segments.source_text: While the concept of a government organization that works closely with AI companies on safety is still new, history shows that this kind of arrangement between government and industry can be highly successful.

segments.authoritative_text: One good example is the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA), a U.S. federal agency that performs safety tests of new motor vehicle models for manufacturers.
segments.source_text: One good example is the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA), a U.S. federal agency that performs safety tests of new motor vehicle models for manufacturers.

segments.authoritative_text: Established in the 1970s to reduce accidents and deaths by encouraging manufacturers to produce safer vehicles, NHTSA led what has become today an industry standard of crash testing and rating vehicles out of five stars according to their safety.
segments.source_text: Established in the 1970s to reduce accidents and deaths by encouraging manufacturers to produce safer vehicles, NHTSA led what has become today an industry standard of crash testing and rating vehicles out of five stars according to their safety.

segments.authoritative_text: Some 50 years since its launch, NHTSA continues to perform crash tests and produce star ratings, as well as issue government safety ratings, safety information, and best practices.
segments.source_text: Some 50 years since its launch, NHTSA continues to perform crash tests and produce star ratings, as well as issue government safety ratings, safety information, and best practices.

segments.authoritative_text: NHTSA is a useful model of a third-party government arbiter that has produced substantial win-win results for the public and for companies.
segments.source_text: NHTSA is a useful model of a third-party government arbiter that has produced substantial win-win results for the public and for companies.

segments.authoritative_text: The administration's rating system lowers costs to consumers by supplying accurate, reliable, and simple safety information for free.
segments.source_text: The administration's rating system lowers costs to consumers by supplying accurate, reliable, and simple safety information for free.

segments.authoritative_text: Meanwhile, companies are incentivized to adopt new and better safety measures into their vehicles.
segments.source_text: Meanwhile, companies are incentivized to adopt new and better safety measures into their vehicles.

segments.authoritative_text: As NHTSA's acting administrator has stated , '[o]ur 5-Star Safety Ratings system continues to give Americans the information they need to choose the vehicle that's right for them. The program also encourages vehicle manufacturers to incorporate advanced vehicle safety technologies into more makes and models, ultimately reducing injuries and deaths on America's roads.'

The program also encourages vehicle manufacturers to incorporate advanced vehicle safety technologies into more makes and models, ultimately reducing injuries and deaths on America's roads.'

segments.authoritative_text: Because safety is a selling point for customers , most of the United States' manufacturers willingly sign up for the NHTSA's 5-star system and use the results in advertising new vehicle models.
segments.source_text: Because safety is a selling point for customers , most of the United States' manufacturers willingly sign up for the NHTSA's 5-star system and use the results in advertising new vehicle models.

segments.authoritative_text: As AISIs mature organizationally, they could fulfill a similar arbiter role for AI models as the NHTSA has for motor vehicles.
segments.source_text: As AISIs mature organizationally, they could fulfill a similar arbiter role for AI models as the NHTSA has for motor vehicles.

segments.authoritative_text: As has been the case with motor vehicles, testing AI models could lead to innovation in which safety is a key competitive feature.
segments.source_text: As has been the case with motor vehicles, testing AI models could lead to innovation in which safety is a key competitive feature.

segments.authoritative_text: AI companies could communicate to customers that their model has passed AISI testing and evaluations, which could in turn help to build public trust and make AI models with higher safety standards more commercially competitive among consumers.
segments.source_text: AI companies could communicate to customers that their model has passed AISI testing and evaluations, which could in turn help to build public trust and make AI models with higher safety standards more commercially competitive among consumers.

segments.authoritative_text: Top frontier AI developers' willingness to work with the U.S. AISI on testing their models before deployment is a good first step to making safety a key feature of AI industry standards, as the NHTSA has done with the U.S. motor vehicle industry over the last 50 years.

segments.authoritative_text: The AISI International Network marks a logical next step in a series of recent bilateral agreements between institutes.
segments.source_text: The AISI International Network marks a logical next step in a series of recent bilateral agreements between institutes.

segments.authoritative_text: In April 2024, the United States signed a memorandum of understanding with the United Kingdom for close collaboration between institutes and established a dialogue with the EU AI Office to jointly develop evaluation tools for AI models.

segments.authoritative_text: Meanwhile, the United Kingdom, for its part, has established additional partnerships with Canada and France on AI safety, and the European Union and Japan have indicated future cooperation between safety institutes in the coming months.

segments.authoritative_text: International consensus would increase regulatory interoperability, or the degree to which different domestic regulatory systems can smoothly interface and interact.
segments.source_text: International consensus would increase regulatory interoperability, or the degree to which different domestic regulatory systems can smoothly interface and interact.

segments.authoritative_text: In this way, interoperability based on common definitions, procedures, and best practices can help to facilitate trade in the future.

segments.authoritative_text: As a previous CSIS paper argued, fragmented legal frameworks that require company compliance with many different obligations can create technical barriers to the free flow of goods and services.
segments.source_text: As a previous CSIS paper argued, fragmented legal frameworks that require company compliance with many different obligations can create technical barriers to the free flow of goods and services.

segments.authoritative_text: Diverging regulatory approaches that require companies to demonstrate that a product is 'safe' according to 10 different metrics from 10 different jurisdictions, for instance, is not only highly inefficient but often prohibitively costly.

segments.authoritative_text: Instead, the AISI International Network could serve as one venue in which to develop a coherent language around AI safety, helping to lower future potential barriers to trade.

segments.authoritative_text: This is important for not only setting safety norms at home, but also advocating for U.S. interests abroad.

segments.authoritative_text: Consider, for instance, the EU AI Act: while the first wave of the act came into force on August 1, the requirements for developers of frontier AI models above 10^25 floating operation points (FLOPS) of compute power have yet to be defined.

segments.authoritative_text: Even if the European Union ultimately decides to develop its codes of practice alone, the network will still provide the United States with a direct line of communication to the EU AI Office for articulating AI safety best practices in the future.

segments.authoritative_text: It is still early days for AI safety institutes, both as organizations and as concepts.
segments.source_text: It is still early days for AI safety institutes, both as organizations and as concepts.

segments.authoritative_text: These should be attainable in the near future to demonstrate continued momentum from the AI Seoul Summit.
segments.source_text: These should be attainable in the near future to demonstrate continued momentum from the AI Seoul Summit.

segments.authoritative_text: When selecting priority areas, members should consider areas with the greatest overlap in AISI's functions, capacity, and expertise, and deliverables that are both impactful and realistic.
segments.source_text: When selecting priority areas, members should consider areas with the greatest overlap in AISI's functions, capacity, and expertise, and deliverables that are both impactful and realistic.

segments.authoritative_text: To start, they should establish a research agenda for the network's technical and guidance safety work going forward.
segments.source_text: To start, they should establish a research agenda for the network's technical and guidance safety work going forward.

segments.authoritative_text: This will help to set the scope of the network's efforts and to keep members on track as they and the network mature.
segments.source_text: This will help to set the scope of the network's efforts and to keep members on track as they and the network mature.

segments.authoritative_text: As discussed in this paper's recommendation to Question 3, the AISI network conference in November may be a good place to set and present this agenda to the public.
segments.source_text: As discussed in this paper's recommendation to Question 3, the AISI network conference in November may be a good place to set and present this agenda to the public.

segments.authoritative_text: Recommendation: It would be premature to assign specific responsibilities to AISI network members today given that most are only months old, if established at all.
segments.source_text: Recommendation: It would be premature to assign specific responsibilities to AISI network members today given that most are only months old, if established at all.

segments.authoritative_text: However, members should consider the benefits and drawbacks of different organizational structures as the network develops.
segments.source_text: However, members should consider the benefits and drawbacks of different organizational structures as the network develops.

segments.authoritative_text: Currently, AISI network members share equal responsibilities by default.
segments.source_text: Currently, AISI network members share equal responsibilities by default.

segments.authoritative_text: While this can be useful for promoting equal participation and accountability from members, it can also add unnecessary costs to collaboration.
segments.source_text: While this can be useful for promoting equal participation and accountability from members, it can also add unnecessary costs to collaboration.

segments.authoritative_text: If each member were to take charge on a different project, for instance, the network could risk losing time, capacity, and focus.
segments.source_text: If each member were to take charge on a different project, for instance, the network could risk losing time, capacity, and focus.

segments.authoritative_text: This kind of structure could also place undue pressure on the capacity and expertise of each of the AISIs to contribute before they are ready.
segments.source_text: This kind of structure could also place undue pressure on the capacity and expertise of each of the AISIs to contribute before they are ready.

segments.authoritative_text: Instead, the AISI network may consider leveraging each member's comparative advantages in expertise, capacity, and funding.
segments.source_text: Instead, the AISI network may consider leveraging each member's comparative advantages in expertise, capacity, and funding.

segments.authoritative_text: Those that are most able to contribute to projects, for instance, should be able and incentivized to do so, as is discussed in Question 7.
segments.source_text: Those that are most able to contribute to projects, for instance, should be able and incentivized to do so, as is discussed in Question 7.

segments.authoritative_text: For now, more mature AISIs like those of the United States, the United Kingdom, and Singapore could have greater responsibilities within the network while other members, such as Kenya or Australia, contribute through more specialized ways.
segments.source_text: For now, more mature AISIs like those of the United States, the United Kingdom, and Singapore could have greater responsibilities within the network while other members, such as Kenya or Australia, contribute through more specialized ways.

segments.authoritative_text: These roles could shift over time as AISIs mature, however.
segments.source_text: These roles could shift over time as AISIs mature, however.

segments.authoritative_text: Recommendation: Currently, the AISI network has a horizontal leadership and consensus or opt-in only voting structure by default.
segments.source_text: Recommendation: Currently, the AISI network has a horizontal leadership and consensus or opt-in only voting structure by default.

segments.authoritative_text: Given that the Seoul Statement makes no indication of leadership and voting structure, however, network members are open to consider different possibilities and their trade-offs.
segments.source_text: Given that the Seoul Statement makes no indication of leadership and voting structure, however, network members are open to consider different possibilities and their trade-offs.

segments.authoritative_text: For example, a consensus-based structure can help to foster good intentions for international cooperation, but it can also make it challenging to take meaningful collective action.
segments.source_text: For example, a consensus-based structure can help to foster good intentions for international cooperation, but it can also make it challenging to take meaningful collective action.

segments.authoritative_text: Similarly, having just one member serve as a leader may seem unfair, but a rotating leadership structure can be ineffectual and prioritize the interests of that country (or bloc) for that period.
segments.source_text: Similarly, having just one member serve as a leader may seem unfair, but a rotating leadership structure can be ineffectual and prioritize the interests of that country (or bloc) for that period.

segments.authoritative_text: The network's leadership and voting structures need not be zero sum, however.
segments.source_text: The network's leadership and voting structures need not be zero sum, however.

segments.authoritative_text: In the long run, members' representation within the network should be proportionate to their contributions; those that invest more time, money, expertise, and resources should be rewarded with a greater say in its direction.
segments.source_text: In the long run, members' representation within the network should be proportionate to their contributions; those that invest more time, money, expertise, and resources should be rewarded with a greater say in its direction.

segments.authoritative_text: This means that the U.S. and UK AISIs would likely be rewarded with leadership of the network due to their organizational capacity.
segments.source_text: This means that the U.S. and UK AISIs would likely be rewarded with leadership of the network due to their organizational capacity.

segments.authoritative_text: The United States, for its part, should aspire to lead the AISI network, as discussed in the third section of this paper.
segments.source_text: The United States, for its part, should aspire to lead the AISI network, as discussed in the third section of this paper.

segments.authoritative_text: Rather than merely insisting on leading, however, it should commit the resources and time that positions it to deserve to lead.
segments.source_text: Rather than merely insisting on leading, however, it should commit the resources and time that positions it to deserve to lead.

segments.authoritative_text: Leadership should be earned based on the scale of meaningful contributions to the field of AI safety science, a structure that also incentivizes on other network members to participate and invest more into AI safety and the AISI network as well.
segments.source_text: Leadership should be earned based on the scale of meaningful contributions to the field of AI safety science, a structure that also incentivizes on other network members to participate and invest more into AI safety and the AISI network as well.

segments.authoritative_text: To do this, the AISI network should emphasize its unique position to provide technical expertise and capacity to governments working on wider AI governance efforts.
segments.source_text: To do this, the AISI network should emphasize its unique position to provide technical expertise and capacity to governments working on wider AI governance efforts.

segments.authoritative_text: In the past year alone, numerous government initiatives have been launched to ensure responsible frontier AI development, including the Biden administration's AI executive order , the EU AI Act , the G7 Hiroshima AI Process Code of Conduct , and the March 2024 UN resolution on AI .
segments.source_text: In the past year alone, numerous government initiatives have been launched to ensure responsible frontier AI development, including the Biden administration's AI executive order , the EU AI Act , the G7 Hiroshima AI Process Code of Conduct , and the March 2024 UN resolution on AI .

segments.authoritative_text: These initiatives, though commendable, are often staffed by diplomats who lack the depth of in-house technical expertise that the AISI network has demonstrated an ability to amass.
segments.source_text: These initiatives, though commendable, are often staffed by diplomats who lack the depth of in-house technical expertise that the AISI network has demonstrated an ability to amass.

segments.authoritative_text: It is this expertise that could turn what are currently high-level principles and frameworks into practical implementation for developers.
segments.source_text: It is this expertise that could turn what are currently high-level principles and frameworks into practical implementation for developers.

segments.authoritative_text: One way to address this could be requiring prospective members to demonstrate their ability to meaningfully contribute to the network-such as through a minimum degree of expertise and capacity-before they can join.
segments.source_text: One way to address this could be requiring prospective members to demonstrate their ability to meaningfully contribute to the network-such as through a minimum degree of expertise and capacity-before they can join.

segments.authoritative_text: The purpose here is not to make the AISI network into an elite club, but to recognize that the network's goal of accelerating AI safety science cannot be realistically achieved by expanding membership to everyone who wants it.
segments.source_text: The purpose here is not to make the AISI network into an elite club, but to recognize that the network's goal of accelerating AI safety science cannot be realistically achieved by expanding membership to everyone who wants it.

segments.authoritative_text: The AISI network could consider partnership programs with other international organizations like GPAI, the OECD, or the Group of 20 (G20) in order to collaborate with interested countries that do not necessarily have the depth of AI safety expertise to join the network.
segments.source_text: The AISI network could consider partnership programs with other international organizations like GPAI, the OECD, or the Group of 20 (G20) in order to collaborate with interested countries that do not necessarily have the depth of AI safety expertise to join the network.

segments.authoritative_text: Such partnerships could help to foster wider international cooperation on AI safety and engage more developing countries on the AISI network's efforts in particular.
segments.source_text: Such partnerships could help to foster wider international cooperation on AI safety and engage more developing countries on the AISI network's efforts in particular.

segments.authoritative_text: While the Seoul Statement is a good start for multilateralizing cooperation between AISIs, network members must now decide how to turn intent into action.
segments.source_text: While the Seoul Statement is a good start for multilateralizing cooperation between AISIs, network members must now decide how to turn intent into action.

segments.authoritative_text: At the November convening in San Francisco, they should strive to set the network's goals, mechanisms, and international strategy in preparation for the AI Action Summit in February 2025.
segments.source_text: At the November convening in San Francisco, they should strive to set the network's goals, mechanisms, and international strategy in preparation for the AI Action Summit in February 2025.

segments.authoritative_text: In doing so, they must ask tough questions, including about priorities, leadership, and membership.
